description: Drive the assets tool: rescan (re-walk the registry + merge the Metro bundle graph + refresh fonts + measure sizes — run this first if the inventory looks stale or empty), measure_sizes (re-measure byte sizes only), detail (full metadata for one asset by id: source dir, per-scale sizes, resolved URI, per-file graph paths), save_baseline (persist the current inventory for before/after comparison — save, make your change, then get_assets shows added/removed/grown/net bytes), clear_baseline, clear_records (wipe + rescan rebuilds).

deviceId.description: The device to act on: its id from list_devices or from your instructions. Pass it whenever more than one app may be connected. Once a call names a device, later calls in this session use it when deviceId is left out.

name: asset_action
